title: UPnP error messages

labels.name: bug
labels.description: A problem with current functionality, as opposed to missing functionality (enhancement)

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: New issues needed to be validated

body:
After upgrading to syncthing v1.27.2, there are numerous UPnP error messages.

For example,

[664CR] 2024/01/06 00:07:57 INFO: Couldn't add port mapping for 192.168.1.11 (external port 43417 -> internal port 22000/TCP): UPnP Error: ConflictInMappingEntry (718)
